task: Ground factual claims for the workspace-monitor Next.js repository monitoring site.
output_summary: A new workspace-monitor Next.js project was added with a static repository snapshot collector, dashboard UI, Vercel static export configuration, deployment docs, installation records, and verification notes.

evidence.reliability: Tracked project folder containing the Next.js app, collector, tests, docs, specs, and generated snapshot files.
Tracked collector script that scans repository Markdown and JSON documents into generated snapshot files.
Tracked dashboard component implementing project, history, document, requirement, and agent views.
Tracked Next.js config using static export settings for Vercel-compatible static deployment.
Tracked deployment guide documenting Vercel project root, build command, output directory, and public review checklist.
Tracked validation log for collector tests, TypeScript check, Next build, npm audit, and HTTP/HTML smoke checks.
Tracked installation audit record for project-local npm dependencies and license/security checks.
Official Next.js documentation for static export behavior.
Official Vercel documentation for deploying Next.js applications.
Official Next.js documentation reviewed while choosing whether to render Markdown through MDX or a generated snapshot preview.
NPM package metadata for the icon dependency used in the UI.

claims.statement: The repository now contains a separate workspace-monitor Next.js project.
verification_steps: Checked the tracked workspace-monitor file list and project registry entry.

claims.statement: The workspace-monitor collector builds repository history, project, agent, requirement, and document data into generated JSON snapshots.
verification_steps: Ran npm run collect and collector tests.

claims.statement: The dashboard UI includes overview, project, history, document, requirement, and agent views with search or filter controls and Markdown/JSON previews.
verification_steps: Inspected MonitorShell.tsx and verified rendered HTML via local HTTP smoke check.

claims.statement: The project is configured for a static Next.js export suitable for later Vercel deployment when the repository is made public or otherwise connected to Vercel.
verification_steps: Checked next.config.mjs, vercel.json, deployment docs, and ran npm run build.

claims.statement: Project-local dependencies were installed and audited, with npm audit reporting zero vulnerabilities at verification time.
verification_steps: Ran npm audit --json and recorded installation details.

uncertainty_notes: Vercel behavior can change over time; deployment instructions should be rechecked against official Vercel and Next.js docs before first production deployment.
The generated snapshot may contain private repository history and must be reviewed before making the repository or deployment public.
limitation_notes: The in-app Browser tool was not exposed in this session, so screenshot verification was replaced with HTTP 200 and rendered HTML content checks.
No live Vercel deployment was created because the repository is currently private and the user asked for Vercel-ready implementation rather than deployment credentials.
